title: Shared UniPoolerCutoverCore step 2 has no recovery branch: a 2-wei donate+sync on the permissionless canonical sUSDS/phUSD pair makes the mainnet cutover core revert for good
description: Core step 2 requires the canonical pair's reserves to be (0,0) both before and after an optional skim, and there is no other branch. Uniswap V2 reserves set by sync() can never return to (0,0) once LP totalSupply is 0: skim() does not touch reserves and burn() needs LP. yield-claim-nft:051's constructor check (UniPoolerV2__PairNotCanonical) binds UniPoolerV2 to factory.getPair(sUSDS, phUSD), so the pooler cannot be pointed at a different pair. Any third party can therefore createPair today (mainnet getPair == 0 at block 26109485), transfer 1 wei of each token and call sync(). After that, every run of the shared core reverts at step 2. The core is inherited by the dev rehearsal (story 101) and by the future mainnet cutover script and fork test (story 103), so this defect propagates to the mainnet operation. docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md §4 (lines 410-414) discusses only in-window griefing between steps 1 and 6, and points to a recovery helper (transfer + pair.mint(UniPoolerV2) with a price check) that does not exist in the core. Pre-emptive poisoning before the run starts is not addressed.
impact: Availability of the Balancexit index-4 cutover, not funds. The revert happens in forge's simulation, before any broadcast, so nothing is half-done. But the 103 script as built on this core cannot run at all until someone writes, reviews and broadcasts a bespoke seeding path under the Balancer wind-down timeline. The griefer's cost is 2 wei plus gas. A recovery exists outside the core (send the recovered tokens to the pair, then pair.mint(newPooler): with LP totalSupply 0 the first minter takes all LP and the griefer's dust is absorbed), which caps severity at Low.
evidence: side-effects.json mainnetForkProbe.tests[1] (test_B_dustSyncedPairPermanentlyBlocksCoreStep2 PASS at block 26109485: reserves (1,1) after sync, pair totalSupply 0, unchanged after skim, core reverts 'UniPoolerCutoverCore: pair reserves not empty'); live read getPair(sUSDS, phUSD) == 0x0. Test A (same file) shows the core otherwise completes on live state.
propagation: Law-1 relevant beyond dev: same code is the planned mainnet cutover (story 103, incomplete).
recommendation: Give the core a reviewed branch for a pre-poisoned pair. When reserves != 0 and pair.totalSupply() == 0, transfer the recovered sUSDS/phUSD to the pair and call pair.mint(newPooler); then require that the resulting reserve ratio matches the Balancer exit ratio within seedToleranceBps and that the griefer's contribution is below a dust bound. Alternatively, do createPair-if-missing + transfer + mint inside one transaction from a small helper, which also closes the in-window case. Add a core unit test that pre-syncs dust and expects the recovery branch to succeed.

title: Phase 9.7's 'minter principal cleared from the legacy strategy' post-condition holds only in forge's simulation; on the broadcast chain 1.2e13 wei of minter principal stays on the de-registered legacy DOLA strategy
severityNote: Dust-sized on a mock chain; may classify as QA. Filed because the script's own require certifies a state the chain does not have.
description: Story 089 requires the minter's DOLA collateral to move off the legacy (MockAutoDOLA) strategy. Phase 9.7 reads principalOf(minter) and passes that number to withdrawAsOwner, then require()s principalOf == 0. forge evaluates both during the simulation pass, where the whole run shares one timestamp, and bakes the amount (5000e18) into calldata. On the broadcast chain (anvil --block-time 2), MockAutoDOLA's time-based _updateYield runs between blocks, so ERC4626YieldStrategy._acquireShares (convertToAssets) credits 5000.000011999712006910e18 at the block-434 minter.mint. The block-436 withdrawAsOwner(5000e18) leaves 11,999,712,006,910 wei behind. The require never runs on chain.
impact: The local end state differs from what dev asserts and logs ('Phase 9.7 end state asserted'). The minter stays the sole principal holder on a strategy that SYA no longer lists and cannot withdraw from, so legacy totalBalanceOf(minter) = 3,299.64 DOLA (all mock yield, including simulate-yield's 2,300) accrues to an unreachable bucket. More broadly, it is a concrete instance where a simulation-time self-assert passes over time-dependent state while the chain diverges.
evidence: side-effects.json stateWrites (YieldStrategyDolaLegacy principal: block 435 = 5000.000011999712006910e18, block 436+ = 11999712006910) and postconditionResults; broadcast txs 433-436 (approve, PhusdStableMinter.mint 5000e18, MockDola.mint, withdrawAsOwner(minter, deployer, 5000e18)); dev-run.filtered.log line for Phase 9.7 shows principal 5000e18 in simulation.
recommendation: Withdraw against the on-chain principal, not a simulation-time number. withdrawAsOwner caps the amount to available principal (AYieldStrategy._withdrawInternal), so passing type(uint256).max, or principal plus a margin, zeroes it on chain. Re-seed the deployer's actual DOLA delta, or accept residual dust explicitly. Alternatively, warp/mine nothing between the seed and the repoint by moving Phase 9.7 to directly follow the Phase 9 seed with no time-dependent vault in between.

title: simulate-yield.sh still feeds MockAutoDOLA after story 089's repoint, so dev's yield-simulation step reaches no live DOLA consumer (disclosed, unlanded story-089 follow-up)
severityNote: Story 089 itself discloses this as a follow-up candidate, carried as [low] at auto-complete. Honest severity is Low; F-class if the classifier treats disclosed follow-ups as faithfulness notes.
description: dev's step 6 ('Simulating yield') mints 2,300 DOLA into the vault at progress.31337.json .contracts.MockAutoDOLA. Since story 089's Phase 9.7, the minter, StableStakerV2 and SYA all sit on YieldStrategyDola over MockSDOLA. SYA no longer lists the legacy strategy, and its withdrawer flag there is revoked. The simulated yield therefore lands only in the legacy vault, and nothing in the live system can skim it. Story 089 (Implementation Notes, line 104; Review, line 216) records this as an out-of-file-list follow-up. simulate-yield.sh is unchanged since baseline, so the follow-up has not landed.
impact: UI developers running npm run dev get no simulated DOLA surplus on the live strategy; SYA claim / yield displays are unaffected by the step that claims to drive them. Local only; no mainnet effect.
evidence: Executed: MockAutoDOLA totalAssets 1000.12 -> 3300.12 DOLA; SYA isRegisteredStrategy(legacy) = false, (sDOLA) = true; legacy totalBalanceOf(minter) = 3,299.64 DOLA, unreachable (see DEV39-02). Story 089 lines 104, 182, 216, 261.
recommendation: Retarget simulate-yield.sh to .contracts.MockSDOLA (or call MockSDOLA.addYield), and assert that YieldStrategyDola's surplus increased. Optionally keep a flag for the legacy vault if V1 exit paths still need it.

title: Phase 9.7's maxMintPerDay restore assertion is vacuous locally: the pre-value is 0, which is exactly what registerStablecoin resets to
severityNote: QA-grade weak guard; possibly within the 2026-09-15 owner ruling's reach since 092's fork tests own the mainnet proof. Filed for the classifier to decide.
description: Story 089's Background names the trap this phase exists to rehearse: registerStablecoin resets maxMintPerDay to 0 (PhusdStableMinter.sol:125), so setMaxMintPerDay must be re-applied. Its acceptance criterion is 'maxMintPerDay equals its value before re-registration'. DeployMocks never sets a non-zero DOLA cap, so prevMaxMintPerDay == 0 (logged: 'maxMintPerDay restored: 0'). If the setMaxMintPerDay line (2521) were deleted, `require(maxMintPerDay == prevMaxMintPerDay)` would still pass.
impact: The rehearsal reports the reset-then-restore ordering as asserted while proving nothing about it. A future regression in that ordering would pass dev silently.
evidence: dev-run.filtered.log Phase 9.7 line 'maxMintPerDay restored: 0'; PhusdStableMinter.registerStablecoin writes maxMintPerDay: 0; grep shows no other setMaxMintPerDay for DOLA in DeployMocks.
recommendation: Seed a non-zero DOLA cap before Phase 9.7 (e.g. setMaxMintPerDay(DOLA, X) at registration) and require prevMaxMintPerDay > 0 as an anti-vacuity gate, matching the pattern Phase 11.7 already uses.
